flags.message:
fix: scope invariant validation to only check affected tasks

- Track modifiedTaskIds in TransactionImpl to know which tasks changed
- Add getModifiedTasks() method returning only dirty tasks
- withTaskStateTransaction now validates only modified tasks, passing
  all tasks as context for cross-task dependency resolution
- validateTaskState() accepts optional context parameter for full
  task list when scoped validation is used
- Pre-existing violations on unrelated tasks no longer block transactions
- Modified tasks that introduce violations are still caught and abort

Fixes TASK-277
